versions.changelog:
Marketing Council skill released — a simulated board of legendary marketing advisors offering expert, often conflicting perspectives on your marketing questions.

- Convene simulated sessions with named marketing legends (Godin, Ogilvy, Hormozi, Dunford, Sutherland, and more), each applying their documented frameworks.
- Provides multi-advisor takes, surfaces real trade-offs and disagreements, and synthesizes a final recommendation with clear next steps.
- Supports several modes: single-advisor quick takes, 3–5 advisor council sessions (default), or an all-advisor full council.
- Includes advisor selection guidance by question type and ensures every session includes at least one natural dissenter.
- Designed for grounded, realistic persona simulation using only what advisors have actually written or said.
